d:
"Alag Aasmaan" is a song that I released back in August 2020 and since then this independent release has received more than 20 million streams across all platforms. An acoustic version of the song is my way of thanking each and every person who helped me cross this number.
This stripped down, guitar only version of the song was recorded 100% LIVE with me singing the entire song in one go while playing the guitar. Having no cuts gives this version the raw feeling that I was looking for. It almost turns this into a brand new single (hah).
